name: Royyala Vepudu
subtitle: prawns tossed dry with onion, curry leaf and a lot of chilli
prepNotes: Prawns take four minutes and not a minute more. Have everything else finished before they go in.
Toss the prawns with the turmeric and salt and refrigerate 15 minutes while the masala cooks down.

steps.text: Fry the onion in the oil until golden and soft, 8 minutes. Add the ginger and garlic and cook 2 minutes.
Add the chilli powder, coriander powder and one sprig of curry leaves. Fry 2 minutes until the oil separates.
Raise the heat, add the prawns and toss constantly for 4 minutes until they curl and turn opaque.
steps.tip: They are done the moment they curl. Past that they tighten into rubber.

steps.text: Add the remaining curry leaves, toss once, check the salt and finish with coriander.

storage: Eat the same day. Reheated prawns toughen, and the dish is dry enough that a day in the fridge does it no favours.
